When extract_images is false, conversion still succeeds and inline images are not extracted

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const html_to_markdown_rs = @import("html_to_markdown_rs");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _result_json = try html_to_markdown_rs.convert("<p>Text with <img src=\"data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAADUlEQVR42mP8/5+hHgAHggJ/PchI7wAAAABJRU5ErkJggg==\" alt=\"pixel\"> image.</p>", "{\"extract_images\":false}");
    defer std.heap.c_allocator.free(_result_json);
    std.debug.print("{s}\n", .{_result_json});

}
```
